title: Hyperliquid Perps: 6-Bug Kill Chain to First Live Fills

context.task: Get HL perps executing real trades with $149.80 deposited in Unified account
context.starting_state: Bot generating 15+ signals per scan but zero fills, zero positions, zero fills on-chain
context.ending_state: 2 verified live fills (AVAX LONG, SUI LONG), both initially profitable

bugs_fixed.title: Exchange(wallet=None) — No Transaction Signing
bugs_fixed.root_cause: Exchange() initialized without a wallet/signer. All state-changing operations silently return None.

bugs_fixed.title: user_state() Returns $0 for Unified Accounts
bugs_fixed.root_cause: user_state() only works for Cross margin. Unified accounts store funds in spot clearinghouse via spot_user_state().
bugs_fixed.fix: Try spot_user_state() first, fallback to user_state()

bugs_fixed.title: slippage=None → int + NoneType Crash
bugs_fixed.root_cause: Passing None as slippage caused SDK crash during price calculation: mid * (1 + None)

bugs_fixed.title: Wrong SDK Method Name for Transfers
bugs_fixed.root_cause: Called transfer_between_spot_and_perp() which doesn't exist. Real method is usd_class_transfer().
bugs_fixed.fix: Discovered via inspect.getsource(), changed to usd_class_transfer(). Then discovered transfers are disabled for Unified accounts anyway.

bugs_fixed.title: Unified Accounts Can't Transfer (And Don't Need To)
bugs_fixed.root_cause: HL returns 'Action disabled when unified account is active'. Unified mode auto-shares equity between Spot and Perps.
bugs_fixed.fix: Removed transfer code entirely. Unified accounts share equity automatically.

bugs_fixed.title: CRITICAL: Slippage Passed as Price ($0.03!)
bugs_fixed.root_cause: SDK signature: market_open(name, is_buy, sz, px=None, slippage=0.05). Our call market_open(sym, True, size, 0.03) passed 0.03 as px (price=$0.03!), NOT as slippage. Every order was priced at $0.03 regardless of asset.
bugs_fixed.fix: Changed to market_open(sym, True, size, slippage=0.03) using keyword argument.
bugs_fixed.severity: CRITICAL — this was THE reason zero trades filled for hours

tuning_lessons.issue: No new trades after first two fills
tuning_lessons.root_cause: MAX_TOTAL_EXPOSURE was $150, already consumed by AVAX ($44.94) + SUI ($40.44) = $85 exposure. A new $25 × 3x = $75 would exceed $150.

tuning_lessons.issue: No TP/SL orders placed on exchange
tuning_lessons.root_cause: Bot tracks TP/SL internally in self.positions dict but never places corresponding orders on HL exchange. If bot restarts, there's zero exit protection.
tuning_lessons.status: UNFIXED — needs on-chain TP/SL via exchange.order() with limit/stop types

tuning_lessons.issue: Profit throttling by daily goal engine
tuning_lessons.root_cause: bank_it mode (150% of goal) capped all trades to $50 max. protect mode (100%) reduced positions 30%. These throttle profit-making.
tuning_lessons.fix: Enabled PARABOLIC_MODE_ENABLED=true, removed profit-side caps from ShamrockGuard. Kept drawdown guard.

debugging_techniques: Used inspect.getsource() to read SDK source code on the VPS at runtime
Used dir(Exchange) to discover available methods when docs were unclear
Added verbose logging of market_open() result to see HL's actual error messages
Validated fills via info.user_fills() to confirm on-chain execution vs phantom fills
Parsed response.data.statuses[0] to catch 'error' keys in otherwise 'status=ok' responses
